info.title: camofox-browser
info.description: Anti-detection browser automation server for AI agents. Accessibility snapshots, element refs, session isolation, cookie import, proxy rotation, and structured logs.

ViewerCapabilityAuth.description: Ephemeral viewer-only capability; not an agent access key.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token matching CAMOFOX_API_KEY (per-route auth for sensitive endpoints like cookie import and traces).

AccessKeyAuth.description: Bearer token matching CAMOFOX_ACCESS_KEY. When set, gates all routes except /health, cookie import, and /stop. Acts as a superkey -- also accepted by endpoints that normally require CAMOFOX_API_KEY.

post.summary: Import cookies into a user session
post.description: Import cookies for authenticated browsing. Requires BearerAuth in production.

get.description: Detailed health with tab/session counts and failure tracking.

post.summary: Proactive memory-pressure cleanup
post.description:
Closes tabs observed idle across multiple checks while preserving tabs
with active/queued operations. Never returns URLs, titles, cookies,
page text, or user IDs. Defaults to dry-run mode.

dryRun.description: When true, returns candidates without closing them.

minIdleMs.description: Minimum idle time (ms) before a tab is eligible.

maxTabsToClose.description: Maximum tabs to close per invocation.

minTabsPerSession.description: Preserve at least this many tabs per session.

closeEmptySessions.description: Close sessions left with zero tabs after cleanup.

200.description: Cleanup result with before/after counts and hashed metadata.

trace.description: Enable Playwright tracing for this session (screenshots, DOM snapshots, network). Must be set on first tab creation; cannot be added to an existing session.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status of the optional initial document navigation.

navigationOk.description: False when the optional initial document navigation returned HTTP 400 or higher.

409.description: Cannot enable tracing on an existing session.

get.description: Returns all tabs for a given userId.

post.summary: Navigate a tab to a URL or macro
post.description: Navigate to a URL or expand a search macro. Auto-creates tab if not found.

200.description: Navigation result. Destination HTTP status is reported even when a rendered error page is available.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status of the final document navigation when available.

navigationOk.description: False when the final document returned an HTTP status of 400 or greater.

sideEffects: Brings the target tab forward while watching; human control preserves user focus.

get.description: Returns accessibility tree with element refs. Supports pagination via offset.

structure.description: Optional bounded read-only DOM summary of forms and tables. The snapshot field remains unchanged.

post.summary: Wait for a selector or timeout
Click an element
post.description: Click by element ref, CSS selector, or coordinates.

coordinates.description: Finite viewport CSS coordinates; out-of-bounds values are rejected.

200.description: Click result with optional post-action snapshot.

409.description: Page changed during the click; caller should take a fresh snapshot and retry with current refs.

post.summary: Attach a file to an upload control
post.description: Attaches files from the configured upload directory without going through the native OS file dialog. Set CAMOFOX_UPLOADS_DIR to a directory that contains the files (default: ~/.camofox/uploads). Two strategies are tried in order: (1) if an <input type="file"> is already present, call Playwright setInputFiles on it directly (works for hidden inputs); (2) otherwise arm a filechooser listener, activate the trigger element (ref or selector) via keyboard (focus + Enter) then a forced click as fallback, and call setFiles on the resulting chooser. Each path must be an absolute path that resolves inside the configured upload directory.

path.description: Absolute path, or array of paths, that resolves within CAMOFOX_UPLOADS_DIR.

ref.description: Trigger element ref (e.g. e36). Optional when an input[type=file] already exists.

selector.description: Trigger element CSS/Playwright selector. Optional when an input[type=file] already exists.

timeout.description: Overall budget in ms to wait for an upload UI (in-app panel input or native file chooser) to appear after the trigger is activated. Ignored values (non-numeric or <= 0) fall back to the default.

400.description: Bad request (missing path/userId; non-regular file; or a path that is missing or outside the configured upload directory).

post.summary: Type text into an element
post.description: Types text into a focused element or a specific ref/selector. Keyboard input stops at the action deadline before its lock is released. A cancelled operation may have partial effects; inspect the page before retrying. Unconfirmed cleanup quarantines the browser and can lose unsaved state.

409.description: Page changed, input was cancelled, or input outcome is unknown. Inspect the returned code and page/session state; never blindly replay partial typing.

post.summary: Select a native form option

option.description: Visible option label or HTML value.

post.summary: Press a keyboard key
Scroll the page
Set the page viewport size
post.description: Physically resizes the page via Playwright's `page.setViewportSize`, triggering a real layout reflow. Use for responsive testing — `window.resizeTo()` is a no-op on non-popup windows.

400.description: Width or height missing or out of range.

post.summary: Go back
Go forward
Refresh page
Save the current tab's PDF as a download artifact

415.description: Current resource is not a PDF.

get.description: Listing never deletes captures by default. Legacy consume=true deletes the returned captures and is a mutation blocked during human control; prefer DELETE on this path for explicit deletion.

parameters.name: consume
parameters.description: Explicitly delete captures after listing; a mutation blocked during human control. Prefer DELETE.

parameters.name: maxBytes
parameters.description: Maximum bytes to inline per captured download.

x-agent-notes.sideEffects: Read-only unless consume=true; consumption deletes captured files and metadata and requires agent control.

consistency.refresh: List downloads after consumption

delete.summary: Delete captured downloads for a tab
delete.description: Deletes captured files and metadata. Requires session ownership and agent control; listing and export do not require deletion.

x-agent-notes.sideEffects: Deletes captured download files and metadata for this tab

consistency.refresh: List downloads after deletion

409.description: Human control or ownership conflict

sideEffects: Brings the target tab forward while watching; human control preserves user focus.

get.description: Returns tab metadata including URL, tool call count, visited URLs, download/failure counts.

post.summary: Evaluate JavaScript in tab
post.description: Runs arbitrary JS in the page context and returns the result.

409.description: Page navigated while evaluating; caller should retry once the page settles.

503.description: Browser session expired; caller should retry to get a fresh session.

post.summary: Structured data extraction via JSON Schema
post.description:
Extracts structured data from the current page using a JSON Schema whose properties
carry `x-ref` hints pointing at snapshot element refs (e.g. `e1`, `e2`).  
Call `GET /tabs/{tabId}/snapshot` first to populate the ref table.

schema.description:
JSON Schema with `type: "object"` and a `properties` map.  
Each property may include `x-ref` (a snapshot element ref) and an optional
`type` (`string`, `number`, `integer`, `boolean`).

required.description: Property names that must resolve to a non-null value.

data.description: Extracted key-value pairs matching the input schema.

400.description: Missing userId, missing schema, or invalid schema.

409.description: No refs available -- call snapshot first.

422.description: Extraction failed (e.g. required ref not found).

delete.description: In native-profile sessions, closing the final tab leaves one managed blank placeholder so the session stays active. Creating another tab removes that placeholder; intentional blank tabs are preserved. Use session suspend to stop the browser.

delete.summary: Close all tabs in a group
delete.description: Closes the tabs present at the start of the request. Native-profile sessions retain one managed blank placeholder when the final tab closes.

get.description: Returns all Playwright trace zip files for the given user session, sorted newest first.
Streams a Playwright trace zip for viewing in trace.playwright.dev.

delete.description: Removes a specific Playwright trace zip from the server.
Closes all tabs and cleans up state for the given userId.

get.description: Returns basic server liveness and browser state.

post.description: The supervised gateway routes this alias using sessionId or the caller default session.

kind.description: Action kind: click, type, scroll, press, key, select_option, drag, hover, screenshot, wait, back, forward.
